title: OL-20261112-10: CF-ACTIONS-TOKEN: move deploy, tick and dashboard to the ultrastable account
body:
**Owner:** ops
**Trigger:** daily
**Done check:** grep:deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json::"state": "running"
**Status:** closed

Acquire a scoped ultrastable-account token or OAuth-free route, then run cf_account cutover.

**Evidence:** ops/deploys.jsonl holds 643 rows for account 81e3 by the oidc route; tick, dashboard, site, agents and tenants each show live_matches_commit true. deploy/cloudflare-accounts.json target.state updated; remaining zone and KV moves are OL-20261118-1.
